doc: docs/FACTORY.md §3. One queue for the box; priority 1 first. Commands run in the repo with no shell; `{python}` is the interpreter running the factory. gate.metric is a dotted path into gate.report. Numbers here are targets and baselines with their source; the factory never writes a shipped asset.
